saveFormat.description: One pick per slot (part id or null) plus the background colour. Store as JSON in a preference; include it in backups.
rules: Draw layers in the 'layers' order; skip empty slots.
Use the *_light eyes and mouth files when the body is in darkBodies or the pattern has darkFace=true.
Antennae: use the file for the chosen body colour.
Clip the finished stack to a circle (radius 40 on the 80 canvas).
